note: Rectifier manifest. Corners are source pixels, ordered top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left. Several reference slices stack three photographs vertically, so corners are absolute pixels in the slice, not in a sub-photo. worldMm is the estimated real width of the crop in millimetres; a mirrored tile spans twice that width. Entries with normal or roughness opt into de-artefacting. Run: pnpm exec npm run textures [out-name ...]

textures.note: Galley base-cabinet door face: flat, evenly lit, strong vertical figure, no hardware.
textures.scaleAnchor: cabinet door stile width in the slice, ~0.72 px/mm
textures.roughnessNote: window serves nine variants across wood.cabinet, wood.trim and panel.locker; sized for the highest target among them (wood.cabinet/ash at 0.60)
textures.normalNote: strength 0 after render review at 0.8 and 0.15. Wood grain FIGURE is a colour boundary, not a height boundary, so the derived normal embosses tone as relief and the veneer reads as crumpled foil. Wrong in kind, not in amplitude. panel.locker gloss at 0.18 amplifies it.
